parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID. Otherwise, the call fails. You can view your instance ID on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice>
If no ID is available for the public instance, refer to [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).
></notice>

parameters.name: SpeechCodeList
parameters.description:
The IDs of the speech corpora to delete. You can obtain the corpus ID from the **Corpus Configuration** console, or call [CreateSpeech](~~217571~~) and use the **Data** field returned upon success as the corpus ID.

N is an integer. Valid values: 1 to 20. This indicates that a maximum of 20 corpora can be deleted at a time.
